extraction_method: ELF64 little-endian section headers, embedded .ze_info YAML and matching .text.<kernel> sizes; c++filt symbol demangling. Only entries containing execution_env retained; kernels_misc_info repetitions excluded.
source_mapping: Demangled functor/function names; no inference from code size or labels
limitations: Static compiler allocation metadata only; no GPU execution/query or achieved occupancy/memory throughput measured.
Kokkos reduction single_task and nd_item variants are both reported; actual dispatch not established by binary inspection.
Missing spill_size and spill_fill_space fields are reported as null/absent, not a measured zero.
private_space allocation with is_simt_thread:true is per work-item; execution_env.private_size is reported separately and must not be confused with this quantity.
Kernel text size is compiled text bytes, not runtime duration or instruction count.
No claim that surface spills or the bulk kernel determine complete-step elapsed time.
